title: Expose internal XPath operation accounting for schema composition
api_or_output: Frozen internal XmlNode/XPathItem XPathEvaluationAccounting overloads and minimal XPathExpression bridge; public XPath API unchanged

acceptance.description: Implement the exact frozen internal accounting join using the existing XPath compiler/evaluator; preserve public API and behavior, and report actual charged operations on success and failure with no private reflection or duplicated evaluator.

Test both context forms, actual accounting in finally, option/cancellation/error propagation, independent runs and exact shared-budget boundaries across several expressions using a capped remaining allowance. Earlier public XPath correctness must remain intact.

Run focused accounting and affected XPath regressions, confirm unchanged public API, and record applicable owned-evaluation allocation parity/evidence under a prepared bounded lease. Reuse valid unchanged primitive evidence; no zero-allocation claim for owned query results or snapshot setup. Record checks at actual tested revisions.
